content:
Dylib injection remains a classic technique for hooking into running processes on macOS. In this post, we will look at how to force a dynamic library into a target process using DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES.
The Vulnerable Target First, let&rsquo;s identify a target. We are looking for binaries that do not have the Hardened Runtime enabled or possess specific entitlements that allow library loading.
You can check entitlements using codesign:
# Check entitlements of a binary codesign -d --entitlements …
